Our hearts literally ached for her. We’ve had set backs along the way and it’s taken far longer than we wanted but, finally, she is in a UK foster home and she’s having a ball.

Princess is an incredibly friendly and cheerful girl who settled instantly in her foster home and quickly behaved like she’d never lived anywhere else!

She gets on well with her foster siblings but could also live happily as the only dog in her forever home. She could live with respectful children aged eight plus.

name: Britney
description:
Britney is a medium, sized, lab-type crossbreed of around 3-4 years old.

Britney is fostered in Marlborough Wiltshire.

We met Britney and her mum and sister when we visited the Botosani public shelter in Romania at the beginning of October last year.

All three travelled to the UK to start a new life away from the horrors of the shelter, and both mum and sister are now happily living in their forever homes.

Britney is a friendly and affectionate girl who is submissive and hand-shy at first, but once she is settled she is extremely sweet and loves a fuss and a cuddle.

Britney will need a resident dog(s) in her new home. She would also be ok with confident cats and respectful children aged eight and over.

name: Havannah
description:
Havannah is a medium sized crossbreed aged around six years old. Havannah fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Havannah came into our care recently as her owner could no longer look after her. After an initial few days of shyness she evolves into a sweet and loving girl who enjoys a fuss and will happily curl up with you on the sofa.

Havannah has lived with dogs and cats but could also be the only dog in her forever home . She walks nicely on a lead and is a calm and quiet addition to the family.

She can live with respectful children 12 plus.

name: Pete
description:
Pete is a large crossbreed aged around eighteen months old. Pete is fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Pete and his siblings were found in a city in Romania in January 2025. Small pups, lost, wandering among cars and all sorts of dangers. The man who found them, being a friend of a friend, asked for Roxana’s help and they were taken to her shelter.

Pete is a typical adolescent dog, clumsily learning the canine lessons of life. He is initially shy with new people and takes time to bond. He is not an overly affectionate dog but will always be close by.

Pete would love to live with another playful dog but could go as the only dog. Pete could live with respectful children aged ten plus. He will need an adopter experienced with large breeds who has the time and patience to win his trust.

name: Dwayne
description:
Dwayne is a large mountain shepherd mix aged around seven years old. Dwayne the rock fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Dwayne has come into our care recently as his owner was no longer able to meet his needs. He is a lovely boy who needs the company of another dog in his forever home.

He’s not selective on who that dog maybe as he appears to be pleasant and sociable with all of them!

Dwayne has the dopiest grin and is a sweet and affectionate boy. We would like a home with large breed experience for him who will not be put off by his booming big boy bark .

Dwayne hasn’t been around children so will need an adult home environment.

name: Carl
description:
Carl is a medium sized crossbreed aged two to three years old. Carl fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Carl was taken into the Botosani public shelter as a pup, nobody remembers who took him there or why. Sadly he didn’t get picked for adoption so he grew up there.

The day that the puppies there get transferred from the puppy block to the adult block is a very depressing day indeed, their chances of ever leaving decrease significantly on that short walk across the shelter

Thankfully Carl is now in a UK foster home. He is a sweet boy who is initially wary of new people but does bond after just a few days. He gets on well with the other dogs in his foster home but could also adjust to being the only dog given time.

He could live with respectful children aged twelve plus.

Carl has a deformity in one of his front legs. It’s possible that he’s had the defect from birth and it doesn’t hold him back or cause him discomfort.

name: Lola
description:
Lola is a medium sized crossbreed. Her passport says she is aged around four years old but we think she could be around six or seven. Lola fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Lola and her four pups were rescued from a kill shelter in Romania. Sadly no adoption offers were forthcoming for any of the family and when we met them at a private shelter in June we agreed to bring them to the UK to find new homes.

Lola is a calm, sweet and friendly girl who enjoys the company of people. Unusually she seems particularly drawn to men but she is happy to get attention from everyone.

She walks nicely on a lead and enjoys her walks. She could live with respectful children aged eight plus.

Lola could live with another calm dog if it wasn’t too in her personal space but would probably prefer to be the only dog in the home. She’s not great with cats.

name: Bruna
description:
Bruna is a female, medium sized crossbreed pup aged around eight to nine months old. Bruna fostered Hempnall Norfolk

Bruna and her mum and siblings were rescued from a kill shelter in Romania. Sadly no adoption offers were forthcoming for any of the family and when we met them at a private shelter in June we agreed to bring them to the UK to find new homes.

Bruna is initially a little timid but is learning the ways of her new world in her UK foster home. She would benefit from the company of another dog in her foster home but could also be the only pet.

She would be ok to live with respectful children aged ten plus.

name: Ken
description:
Our extra special boy Ken is approximately four years old and a rather large cross breed with a huge presence.

Ken weighs twenty-nine kilos and measures seventeen inches from shoulder to paw. Sadly, Ken’s owner had to leave the island suddenly and he was surrendered to our Cyprus shelter two months ago.

Our shelter manager describes Ken as an amazingly intelligent lad with truly exceptional manners. Ken is full of gentility, character and personality.

His favourite play is to gain attention by a gentle tap with one of his front paws. Such a kind boy and so affable, affectionate and loving.

Ken so enjoys socialising: he really is a people kind of boy. With his radiant smile Ken oozes joy and happiness. In doing so he simply lights up the room. Ken’s appearance is glorious with his light tan coat and splashes of white.

Ken walks nicely on his lead and thoroughly enjoys his time in the car. He seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, children and cats.

name: Chloe
description:
Our extra special girl Chloe is around three years old and almost certainly a Labrador or thereabouts.

Chloe weighs twenty-three kilos and measures sixteen inches from shoulder to paw. Having been found abandoned on the streets, has been in our Cyprus shelter for just one month.

Our shelter manager describes Chloe as bubbly and bright. She has the nicest smile we have ever seen which is almost perpetual.

Chloe lights up the room with her calm, loving, empathic and caring personality. Her natural gentility and kindness instantly wins so many hearts.

Chloe’s appearance is exceptional. She has a soft white coat running into cream with hints of light tan. And then of course her two dark tan ears and enormous puppy dog eyes.

An absolute star whose fortunate adopters will be blessed. She could hardly be more deserving.

Chloe walks really nicely on her lead and enjoys her time in the car. She seems to mix perfectly well with other dogs, cats and children.

name: Ree
description:
Ree is a medium sized crossbreed aged around fourteen months old. Ree fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Ree and her sister Rox were found in the middle of nowhere in Romania, near a road, obviously abandoned, without food, water, or shelter.

It was last summer, when temperatures were soaring outside. They were taken by the Animal Police and taken to Roxana’s shelter.

Ree is a loving and loyal girl with a cheeky personality. She is initially shy of new people and new situations but is growing in confidence in her foster home.

She is wary of traffic and will need a rural home or quietish area where she can have time to grow in confidence out and about.

She mixes well with other dogs but could also be the only dog in the home. She will need a cat free home and can live with children aged eight plus.

name: Boris
description:
Boris is a large sized crossbreed aged around 11 years old.Boris fostered Watton, Norfolk.

Boris is a large dog who is unaware that his size doesn’t equate to him being a lap dog, however hard he tries. He is a gentle giant who loves nothing more than nuzzling up to his foster family for cuddles and kisses.

He spends most of his time as if a shadow of his fosterers, wherever we go, he goes. Whatever you are doing in the house, Boris will be right there by your side.

He loves his walks and can be out for quite some time, he also likes going to an enclosed field for a runaround and his favourite activity, a roll in the grass. He walks wonderfully on the lead and plods along nicely.

He loves his humans and gets the zoomies daily when his fosterers get home from work, as well as an incredibly waggy tail.

Apart from his spurts of energy, Boris is a very chilled out dude who likes the simple things of walks, food, fuss, and sleep.

Boris currently lives in a home with other dogs but would be quite happy to be the only dog in the house, where attention to him can be undivided. He cannot live with cats. He needs an adult home.

name: Denzel
description:
Denzel is fostered in Mattishall Norfolk.

Denzel is a small to medium-sized crossbreed, around 2 to 3 years old, with the cutest little legs and a long body that suggests there might be a bit of Corgi and Spaniel somewhere in his family tree.

Whatever his mix, one thing is certain, he’s absolutely adorable.

Denzel’s story didn’t begin with the love and security every dog deserves. He was rescued from a pack of dogs surviving on the streets of Romania, in an area where cruelty towards dogs was sadly commonplace.

Many of the dogs rescued alongside him had suffered horrific injuries, including broken limbs. Miraculously, Denzel escaped without any major physical injuries, but the emotional scars of his past are harder to see.

Because of this, Denzel is understandably cautious around new people. He isn’t the sort of dog who will throw himself into the arms of strangers, and that’s okay.

He simply needs someone willing to let him go at his own pace. The beautiful thing about Denzel is that once you’ve earned his trust, his cheeky, affectionate personality begins to shine through.

He’s sweet, quietly funny, and has so much love tucked away, just waiting for the right person to discover it.

Denzel is currently living happily in a multi-dog foster home and absolutely thrives with canine company. Watching him with the other dogs is lovely!

He’s relaxed, confident, and enjoys playing when he thinks the humans aren’t looking! Because of how much he relies on other dogs for reassurance, he will need at least one friendly, confident resident dog in his forever home.

Cats, however… let’s just say the relationship between Denzel and the Safe Rescue cat is less of a friendship and more of a mutual agreement to disagree! For that reason, he is looking for a cat-free home.

Denzel could happily live with sensible, respectful children aged 12 years and over who understand that he will need time, patience and space to settle.

Denzel isn’t looking for perfection. He isn’t looking for someone who expects an instant best friend. He’s looking for someone who understands that love built on trust is worth waiting for.

If you’re the kind of person who celebrates the little victories… a first tail wag, a gentle nudge for affection, a dog choosing to lie beside you because he finally feels safe, then Denzel might just be the one you’ve been waiting for.

name: Rama
description:
Rama is a medium sized crossbreed aged around a year old. Rama fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Rama was a pup born to a chained mum in Romania. Thankfully she was spared the horrendous fate of chained life when all of the dogs were handed over to a rescuer, Rama and her mother included.

Rama is a quiet and sweet little girl who has lived in the shadow of her mum at the shelter. She’s now in a UK foster home and time spent with people is resulting in her absolutely flourishing.

She is a quiet little girl, currently a little serious for her age, hopefully in the coming weeks she will learn more about the fun side of life.

She mixes well with other dogs and is fine with the safe rescue cat, she could also be the only dog in the home. She could live with respectful children aged six plus.

name: Alfie
description:
Alfie is a German shepherd cross aged around four years old. Alfie fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Alfie and his siblings were found as puppies in a wood yard in Romania adjacent to a very busy highway. The three pups were rescued and taken to a safe shelter where they grew up safely.

Alfie’s two sisters, Alice and Alba, were adopted along the way but Alfie has spent four years waiting for his chance to come to the UK to find a home.

Alfie is a biggish chap who would suit an experienced shepherd owner. He is mixing well with dogs in his foster home but maybe best as an only dog or with just one steady female.

He has met the very robust safe rescue cat and ignored him. Alfie has little experience with children and we would be looking for a home with no children under the age of twelve.

Alfie loves his walks and walks nicely on a lead.

name: Letty
description:
Letty is a medium sized crossbreed aged around seven years old. Letty fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Letty has come into our care recently due to a change in domestic circumstances. She is a quiet and sweet girl who is initially timid with new people.

She will need a confident dog to buddy up to in her forever home and when she sees them relaxed and approaching people for fuss she will then follow suit. She would therefore not be happy as the only dog in the home.

Letty would like a quiet and calm home with no children under the age of twelve. She walks nicely on a lead and has met amicably with the safe rescue cat.

name: Teddy
description:
Meet Teddy, a delightful little boy with a happy heart and a fun-loving personality!

Teddy is a lovely, cheerful boy who enjoys being around people and gets on well with other dogs.

He has experience of living in a foster home, so he already has some understanding of home life and what it means to be part of a family.

Teddy is a fun little character who is ready to bring love, laughter and companionship to his very own people. He does walk on a lead, although he will benefit from continued training and encouragement as he settles into his new life.

Teddy is neutered, vaccinated and has his pet passport, so he is all ready to start his next adventure!

Teddy would love a home where he can feel safe, loved and part of the family. He is cat-friendly.

He could potentially live with sensible children, preferably older children who understand how to treat a dog kindly and respectfully.

He may also be able to share his home with another friendly dog.

A secure garden is essential, giving Teddy somewhere safe to explore and helping him settle into his new surroundings.

We would like him to have time to get comfortable with his home and family before gradually venturing further afield on walks.

Although Teddy has lived in a foster home, moving to a new family is still a big change. His adopters should be prepared to give him time, patience and ongoing support with his lead training as he finds his feet.

Teddy is a happy, affectionate and thoroughly delightful little boy who deserves a family to call his own. Could that be you?

If you think Teddy could be the perfect addition to your family, please visit www.savingandrehomingstrays.org to find out more about adopting from Saving and Rehoming Strays.

A home check and adoption donation apply. Applicants must be able to travel to Ayr to meet Teddy and, if successful, collect him.

name: Lotty
description:
Lotty is a medium sized crossbreed aged around two years old.

The team met Lotty on their trip to Roxanas shelter back in June. She was a late addition to the transport list after they noticed that she was getting severely picked on by her pen mates every time the dogs all barked.

It was decided she really needed to be free from the bullies and so she was swiftly added.

Lotty is a timid girl initially who is not brave in new situations. She is learning to accept new things all the time and becoming braver but will still need to gain life experience in her forever home.

Once comfortable she is cheeky and affectionate and great fun. Lotty will need an adult family with one other dog in the household as full time resident. She has been fine with the safe rescue cat but may chase a more nervy cat when she found her feet.

name: Maudy
description:
Maudy is a 1 year old female Cross-Breed.

This happy little girl is ready to find a family of her own, and we think she is going to bring so much joy to the lucky people who welcome her home.

Maudy is a cheerful, friendly girl who loves people and gets on well with other dogs. She has a lovely nature and is a real delight to be around.

Now all she needs is someone to give her the chance to discover just how wonderful life in a loving home can be.

Maudy was found with a broken leg, but thankfully this has been successfully repaired and she has no ongoing issues from her injury.

She has been through a lot, but she hasn’t lost her happy spirit, and now it is time for her next chapter.

Maudy hasn’t yet experienced life in a home, so her new family will need to be patient and help her learn all the little things that many dogs take for granted.

She will need support with basic house training and getting used to household routines.

She has started walking on a lead, but she will need continued training and encouragement to build her confidence and skills. A secure garden will be essential.

Maudy needs time to settle into her new home, get to know her family and become comfortable in her surroundings before gradually venturing out on walks. She is cat-friendly.

There is no need to rush her; the important thing is to help her feel safe and secure as she learns about her new world.

Maudy could potentially live with sensible children, preferably older ones who understand how to behave kindly and respectfully around a dog.

She could also live with another friendly, compatible dog.

A happy, friendly girl who enjoys people and other dogs.

Spayed, vaccinated and has her pet passport. Her previously broken leg has been repaired, with no ongoing issues.

A secure garden and a family willing to help her settle.

Patience with house training, lead skills and all the new experiences of home life.

Maudy is a delightful little girl with so much love and happiness to share. She doesn’t need a perfect home or a family who knows everything already; she needs people who will give her time, kindness and the opportunity to learn at her own pace.

Could you be the family who helps Maudy begin her wonderful new life?

name: Greyson
description:
Greyson is an eight month old cross-breed pup who will grow to be around medium sized. Greyson fostered Norwich Norfolk.

Greyson was found on the side of a road in Romania with his brother. They were feeding from the corpse of a deceased dog as there was no other food source around. Sadly Greysons brother later died of parvo after they were rescued.

Despite this horrific start in life Greyson has arrived in the UK and is quite a character. Just a cheeky little chap on the look out for his next bout of fun. He mixes well with other dogs and would like another dog in his forever home.

He is a little wary of strangers but once he connects with you he will be your very best friend. Greyson wants to play with the safe rescue cat and can live with respectful children aged ten plus.
